subject: Executive briefing & coverage plan for SlateLine demo
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Anika Shah <anika.shah@slateline.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SlateLine exec briefing — VP/CTO attendance & coverage

Hi Anika —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per Rajiv’s note, we’d like to lock an executive briefing/demo where your VP of Product and CTO can join for a 45-minute live walkthrough of the integration patterns we discussed. Goal: a short 20-minute demo focused on latency/cost controls and a 20-minute Q&A for architecture and procurement questions.

Can you confirm whether the VP (you mentioned Priya) and CTO Rajiv can make time during the week of July 10? We’re happy to hold a 30–45 minute window that fits their schedule.

Plan from our side: Marissa (VP Engagement) will open with the business context and high-level SLO commitments; Ben (solutions engineer) will lead the technical demo and highlight the routing/quantization profiles; I’ll handle the follow-ups and MC.

I attached a proposed agenda and a one-pager runbook for executive handoff. If Priya/Rajiv want a shorter executive-only pre-brief, we can do a 15-minute pre-call the day before.

Attachments: slateline-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF), redwood-runbook-v1.docx (Word)

Best,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0191

Soojin —

Thanks — that agenda looks good. Priya (VP Product) is available July 11 between 10:30–12:00 PT or July 12 between 14:00–16:00 PT. Rajiv would prefer July 11 after 11:00 PT.

A couple quick asks from our side:
- We’ll need a short paragraph (one pager) that outlines where data will be persisted and retention controls for demos with real data.
- Can you share who will be the ‘executive backup’ in case Priya gets pulled into a conflict? Helpful to know who from your side can speak to SLA/contract questions.

I copied Rajiv so he can confirm the 11:00+ window on the 11th. If that works, I’ll send the calendar invite to Priya, Rajiv and a couple procurement leads.

-Anika
Head of Partnerships | SlateLine
anika.shah@slateline.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 2 Jul 2028 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SlateLine exec briefing — VP/CTO attendance & coverage

Anika —

Great — July 11 at 11:15 PT would work from our side. We can do a 45-minute block: 11:15–12:00 PT. Marissa will handle the executive framing and SLA high-levels; Ben will run the demo and surface the data retention/architecture slide you requested.

Quick answers to your asks:
- Data retention: we will bring a one-paragraph summary in slide 2 that describes transient KV caching, customer-configurable retention windows for logs, and integrations with KMS for key management. We will not persist customer prompt content beyond the demo environment unless you explicitly enable it.
- Executive backup: Marissa Cole is my primary executive cover; if Priya is unavailable Marissa will step in for strategic/contract conversations and can commit to follow-up with the legal team. 

I’ve attached an updated runbook with those bullets called redwood-runbook-v1.docx and a short demo agenda PDF. I’ll wait for Rajiv to confirm and then we can send a calendar request and a short pre-brief calendar note (15 mins) the day prior.

Proposed calendar: July 11, 11:15–12:00 PT — Exec briefing + technical Q&A (45m)

Attachments: redwood-runbook-v1.docx, slateline-demo-agenda.pdf

Thanks —
Soojin

Looping in my availability and a short execution note.

Soojin — I can be the executive cover and take the first 10 minutes to set the contract milestone expectations (SLA windows, pilot timelines, procurement touchpoints). Also recommended: a 15-minute pre-brief for executives the morning of July 11 at 09:30 PT to align on the ask and who owns the follow-up items. That keeps things tight and avoids exec surprises. If logistics are tight, we can skip but I prefer the alignment.
